sections.①:
• 브랜드명: AWS (Amazon Web Services)
  • 한 줄 정체성: 2006년 시작한 글로벌 1위 클라우드 인프라 — 200+ 서비스의 콘솔/API
  • 공식 디자인 철학: Cloudscape Design System — "Designed for AWS, Built for the world's largest cloud"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: AWS 오렌지(#FF9900) 액센트 + 짙은 네이비 사이드바(#232F3E) + Polaris 콘솔의 정보 밀집 카드. Amazon 본가의 오렌지와 같지만 톤은 더 인프라-엔지니어링적
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 인프라, 정확, 신뢰
  • 무드 설명: 라이트 콘솔이 기본이며 공식 다크 모드도 제공한다. 짙은 글로벌 헤더와 AWS 오렌지 액센트 아래 정보 밀집 표·카드를 배치하고, 리소스 ID는 monospace, 상태는 시맨틱 색으로 빠르게 스캔되게 한다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 (Cloudscape)
  • 밀도(Density): Compact — 콘솔은 정보량 우선
  • 모서리 성향: Soft (4~8px)
  • 평면성: Flat — 1px 보더만
sections.③:
:root {
  /* Primary - AWS Orange (Squid Ink + Anchor Orange) */
  --color-primary-50:  #FFF4E0;
  --color-primary-100: #FFE2A8;
  --color-primary-200: #FFCD66;
  --color-primary-300: #FFB429;
  --color-primary-400: #FFA61C;
  --color-primary-500: #FF9900;   /* AWS Orange */
  --color-primary-600: #EC7211;
  --color-primary-700: #D55F00;
  --color-primary-800: #A04200;
  --color-primary-900: #6B2C00;

  /* Secondary - AWS Squid Ink (네이비) */
  --color-secondary-500: #232F3E;
  --color-secondary-700: #161E2D;
  --color-secondary-900: #0F1419;

  /* Service category accents */
  --service-compute: #F58536;
  --service-storage: #5294CF;
  --service-database: #E03F37;
  --service-ml:       #01A88D;

  /* Neutral (Cloudscape grays) */
  --color-neutral-0:    #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral-50:   #FAFAFA;
  --color-neutral-100:  #F2F3F3;
  --color-neutral-200:  #EAEDED;
  --color-neutral-300:  #D5DBDB;     /* border */
  --color-neutral-500:  #879596;
  --color-neutral-700:  #545B64;
  --color-neutral-800:  #232F3E;
  --color-neutral-900:  #161E2D;
  --color-neutral-1000: #000000;

  /* Semantic - 인프라 상태용 */
  --color-success-bg: #E1F2EC;
  --color-success-fg: #067D62;       /* Running */
  --color-warning-bg: #FEF6E0;
  --color-warning-fg: #B25800;       /* Stopping/Pending */
  --color-error-bg:   #FDE7E9;
  --color-error-fg:   #D13212;       /* Failed */
  --color-info-bg:    #E5F0FF;
  --color-info-fg:    #0972D3;       /* Info */

  /* Surface */
  --bg-base:     #FAFAFA;
  --bg-subtle:   #F2F3F3;
  --bg-elevated: #FFFFFF;
  --bg-header:   #232F3E;
  --bg-sidebar:  #16191F;
  --bg-overlay:  rgba(22,30,45,0.55);

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:    #161E2D;
  --text-secondary:  #545B64;
  --text-tertiary:   #879596;
  --text-link:       #0972D3;
  --text-link-hover: #033160;
  --text-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-on-dark:    #FFFFFF;
  --text-disabled:   #879596;

  /* Border */
  --border-default: #D5DBDB;
  --border-subtle:  #EAEDED;
  --border-strong:  #879596;
  --border-focus:   #0972D3;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-base: #0F1419;
  --bg-subtle: #161E2D;
  --bg-elevated: #1F2937;
  --text-primary: #FAFAFA;
  --text-secondary: #D5DBDB;
  --border-default: #2C3340;
}
sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문: Amazon Ember (자체) → Helvetica Neue / Arial 폴백
    • 한글: Amazon Ember Korean / Noto Sans KR 폴백
    • 코드/리소스 ID: Source Code Pro / Monaco / Consolas
  • 위계 (Cloudscape Type Ramp):
    • Display: 28px / 700 / 1.2 / -0.015em
    • H1: 22px / 700 / 1.3 / -0.01em
    • H2: 18px / 700 / 1.35 / -0.005em
    • H3: 16px / 700 / 1.4 / 0
    • Body Large: 14px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Body: 14px / 400 / 1.45 / 0
    • Body Strong: 14px / 600 / 1.45 / 0
    • Body Small: 12px / 400 / 1.4 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 600 / 1.4 / 0.02em
    • Code: 13px / 400 / 1.5 'Source Code Pro', monospace

sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 700 14px/1 'Amazon Ember', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0;
       border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid;
       display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); border-color: var(--color-primary-600); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-400); }
.btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
.btn-link { background: transparent; color: var(--text-link); border-color: transparent; padding: 8px 0; }
.btn-link:hover { color: var(--text-link-hover); text-decoration: underline; }
.btn-danger { background: #fff; color: var(--color-error-fg); border-color: var(--color-error-fg); }

Input

.input { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 10px; font: 400 14px/1.4 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); }
.input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--border-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(9,114,211,0.30); }
.input-code { font: 400 13px/1.4 'Source Code Pro', monospace; }
.select { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 28px 7px 10px; font: 400 14px/1.4 inherit; appearance: none; }

Card (Resource)

.resource-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 12px 14px; }
.resource-card .head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.resource-card .id { font: 600 13px/1.3 'Source Code Pro', monospace; color: var(--text-primary); }
.resource-card .meta-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; font: 400 12px/1.4 inherit; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.resource-card .meta-grid .label { font: 700 11px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.resource-card .meta-grid .value { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 2px; }

Badge / Tag (Status)

.status { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 11px/1.4 inherit; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.status::before { content: '●'; font-size: 9px; }
.status-running  { background: var(--color-success-bg); color: var(--color-success-fg); }
.status-pending  { background: var(--color-warning-bg); color: var(--color-warning-fg); }
.status-failed   { background: var(--color-error-bg);  color: var(--color-error-fg); }
.status-info     { background: var(--color-info-bg);   color: var(--color-info-fg); }
.tag-svc { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font: 700 10px/1.4 inherit; }
.tag-svc.compute { background: rgba(245,133,54,0.15); color: var(--service-compute); }
.tag-svc.storage { background: rgba(82,148,207,0.15); color: var(--service-storage); }
.tag-svc.db      { background: rgba(224,63,55,0.15); color: var(--service-database); }
.tag-svc.ml      { background: rgba(1,168,141,0.15); color: var(--service-ml); }

Navigation (Top + Sidebar)

.navbar { background: var(--bg-header); color: #fff; padding: 0 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 40px; }
.navbar .logo { font: 700 16px/1 'Amazon Ember', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }
.navbar .services { color: #fff; font: 700 12px/1 inherit; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px; }
.navbar .services::before { content: '▮'; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.navbar .search { flex: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; font: 400 12px/1.4 inherit; color: var(--text-on-dark); max-width: 400px; }
.navbar .region { margin-left: auto; font: 400 12px/1.4 inherit; color: #D5DBDB; }
.sidebar { background: var(--bg-sidebar); color: #fff; width: 240px; padding: 12px 0; }
.sidebar .item { padding: 8px 14px; font: 400 13px/1.4 inherit; color: #D5DBDB; cursor: pointer; }
.sidebar .item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #fff; }
.sidebar .item.active { background: rgba(255,153,0,0.12); color: var(--color-primary-500); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-primary-500); padding-left: 11px; }
sections.⑪: 1. Amazon 본가 톤(밝은 파스텔, 둥근 카드) 사용 금지 — AWS는 짙은 네이비 + 정보 밀집 2. 카드 모서리 12px 이상 라운드 금지 — Cloudscape는 8px 표준 3. 리소스 ID / IP / ARN을 본문 폰트로 표시 금지 — 반드시 monospace 4. 상태 배지를 단색 칠로 만들지 말 것 — 시맨틱 배경(연하게) + 시맨틱 텍스트 + ● 도트 5. 콘솔 헤더 색에 그라데이션·라이트 톤 사용 금지 — Squid Ink #232F3E 단색
sections.⑫:
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: 'Amazon Ember', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; }
  button { font-family: inherit; }
  .aws-demo { min-height: 100vh; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .aws-topbar { height: 48px; padding: 0 var(--space-lg); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-lg); background: #131A22; color: #fff; }
  .aws-wordmark { position: relative; padding: 0 2px 5px; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -1.5px; line-height: 1; }
  .aws-wordmark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 3px; right: -2px; bottom: 1px; height: 5px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); border-radius: 0 0 75% 75%; transform: rotate(3deg); }
  .aws-services { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
  .aws-services::before { content: '▦'; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .aws-search { flex: 1; max-width: 560px; min-width: 140px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #56616F; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 0 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #AAB7C4; font-size: 13px; }
  .aws-search kbd { margin-left: auto; padding: 1px 5px; border: 1px solid #667482; border-radius: 3px; color: #D5DBDB; font: 11px/1.3 inherit; }
  .aws-top-meta { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: #D5DBDB; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .aws-shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 224px minmax(0,1fr); min-height: calc(100vh - 48px); }
  .aws-side { padding: var(--space-md) 0; background: var(--bg-elevated); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .aws-side-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 14px 12px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
  .aws-ec2-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #161E2D; font-size: 17px; }
  .aws-side-group { padding: 12px 10px 4px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .aws-side-link { margin: 1px 8px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; }
  .aws-side-link.active { padding-left: 8px; border-left: 3px solid var(--color-primary-500); background: rgba(255,153,0,.10); color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 700; }
  .aws-main { min-width: 0; }
  .aws-crumb { height: 38px; padding: 0 var(--space-xl); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: var(--bg-elevated); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 12px; }
  .aws-crumb a { color: var(--text-link); font-weight: 600; }
  .aws-page-hero { padding: var(--space-xl); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-xl); background: var(--bg-elevated); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .aws-page-hero h1 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .aws-page-hero p { margin: 0; max-width: 650px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .aws-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: var(--space-sm); }
  .aws-actions .btn { white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
  .aws-actions .btn-primary { color: #161E2D; }
  .aws-content { padding: var(--space-xl); }
  .aws-feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: var(--space-lg); margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); }
  .aws-feature-grid .resource-card { min-height: 150px; padding: var(--space-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .aws-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
  .aws-card-icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(255,153,0,.13); color: var(--color-primary-600); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; }
  .aws-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .aws-card-kicker { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
  .aws-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: var(--space-sm); }
  .aws-metric strong { display: block; font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.1; }
  .aws-metric span { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
  .aws-metric .ok { color: var(--color-success-fg); }
  .aws-chart { width: 100%; height: 58px; display: block; }
  .aws-chart-labels { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }
  .aws-quick { display: grid; gap: 7px; }
  .aws-quick a { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 7px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); color: var(--text-link); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
  .aws-quick a:last-child { border-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .aws-table-wrap { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .aws-tablebar { padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .aws-tablebar h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; }
  .aws-filter { margin-left: auto; min-width: 220px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 12px; }
  .aws-table { min-width: 760px; }
  .aws-tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(180px,1.5fr) 100px 120px 80px minmax(130px,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); font-size: 12px; }
  .aws-tr:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .aws-tr.head { padding-top: 8px; padding-bottom: 8px; background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
  .aws-check { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 2px; }
  .aws-id,.aws-ip { font-family: Consolas, Monaco, monospace; }
  .aws-id { color: var(--text-link); font-weight: 600; }
  .aws-cpu { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-success-fg); font-weight: 700; }
  @media (max-width: 780px) {
    .aws-top-meta,.aws-side { display: none; }
    .aws-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .aws-page-hero { flex-direction: column; }
    .aws-actions { margin-left: 0; }
    .aws-feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .aws-search kbd { display: none; }
    .aws-content,.aws-page-hero { padding: var(--space-lg); }
    .aws-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
  }
</style>
